column2: planned step order renders the persisted drop notice before the durable-note `note_readable_any_head()` fallback. when `dropped_note_artifact` is pre-seeded or already exists, step 5 (`read_dropped_note_notice`) fills `section` before the fallback at steps 7–8 inside `if not section`, so the durable note never renders, `clear_dropped_note_notice()` never runs, the planned stale-marker regression test fails, and recovery from spurious persists (e.g. persist succeeded but invalidate failed, or rerun after partial failure) remains blocked. the edge-case text stating drop markers render first conflicts with that test and the stale-marker recovery goal.
